verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Terraform's native configuration language (HCL) as a 'human-readable configuration file' language, not a general-purpose programming language with types/loops in the sense of Python/TypeScript; there is no CDKTF or similar general-purpose-language authoring mentioned anywhere in the pack. Community feedback even criticizes it as 'the awful half-baked language,' reinforcing that Terraform's core authoring experience is a declarative DSL rather than a GPL with IDE-native type/loop support.
